annotations.title: Buy a 7-day Route Pass ($1, up to 300 calls)

description: For agents that route many tasks: one x402 payment of $1 returns a pass token that unlocks route_task, seller_benchmark and market_map for 7 days (up to 300 successful calls; route_task lists at $0.02). Then set the MCP client header "Authorization: Bearer <pass>" or pass _meta["arbiter/pass"]. PAID: $1.00, no account. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). An unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing; bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/pass/week.
name: buy_route_pass_week
title: Buy a 7-day Route Pass ($1, up to 300 calls) ($1.00)
